statement: The `golden` block MUST carry exactly five components, and a percentage MUST NOT be reported without the per-tier breakdown.
control: by_provenance sums to 49 and its three golden tiers sum to 35, matching total_intent and golden_count. A validator that only checks presence passes an envelope whose numbers contradict each other, so the components must be asserted individually rather than inferred from one another.
note: golden_tiers restates PROV-010's trusted set so a consumer need not hard-code it.
